info.title: KABBAK API
info.description: Read-only API backend for the KABBAK frontend. All content responses use a {data, meta?} envelope (see README). Protected routes accept x-api-key or Authorization: Bearer <key>. Named clients can carry a basic, premium, or pro+ accessLevel, plus optional roles and scopes for privileged admin routes.

FreeformJson.description: Endpoint-specific JSON payload. The exact shape varies by route. (Legacy; most endpoints now use ApiSuccess envelope.)

ResponseMeta.description: Optional metadata attached to success responses for pagination, tracing and versioning.

requestId.description: Unique identifier for the request, echoed from x-request-id or generated.

version.description: API/service version at the time of the response. Allows GUIs to detect shape changes.

total.description: Total number of items available (for list/paginated responses).

count.description: Number of items in this response page.

ApiSuccess.description: Standard success envelope for all content API responses. GUIs should expect data + optional meta.

data.description: Primary payload. May be object, array, or primitive depending on endpoint.

JsonPayload.description: Standard JSON success response using the ApiSuccess envelope.

Unauthorized.description: A valid API key was not supplied.

Forbidden.description: The authenticated client does not have enough access for this resource.

BadRequest.description: The request parameters could not be processed.

NotFound.description: The requested resource was not found.

StorageUnavailable.description: The API process is live, but the storage snapshot is not ready.
